verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party claim of a royalty-free license, and community evidence directly indicates the opposite: Unreal charges once a game's revenue exceeds $1M ('Only way to pay to use Unreal Engine is to earn more than 1,000,000 usd'), and users cite real royalty costs (e.g., 'that would have cost them $150k'), with one calling the free framing misleading ('free... with a lot of strings attached'). This shows Unreal's actual model includes revenue-based royalties above a threshold, not the no-royalty/no-fee licensing the story requires.
